testcase.name: Scenario: Switch among compact wheel layouts: tmp/obk-wheel-size-3943-source/features/application/viewport-navigation-wheel/viewport-navigation-wheel.feature:40:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Switch among compact wheel layouts ✔ Given the full navigation wheel is open over a visible model in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Mini View Object Wheel ✔ Then a small segmented circular wheel appears ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel and chooses Mini Tour Building Wheel ✔ Then a small segmented circular wheel remains visible ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel ✔ Then Mini Tour Building Wheel is marked as the selected layout ✔ When the user chooses Mini Full Navigation Wheel ✔ Then a small circular wheel with more segments appears ✔ When the user right-clicks the wheel ✔ Then Mini Full Navigation Wheel is marked as the selected layout ✔ When the user chooses Full Navigation Wheel ✔ And the user presses Escape ✔ Then the wheel disappears ✔ And the model remains visible in the same apparent view ✔ And the status area displays Ready
